featuredProjects.sectionSubtitle: Applied machine learning and software development

items.title: TourlyAI: NLP for tourism reviews
items.desc: Academic project: an Electron, React, and Python desktop app for exploring tourism reviews. Combines two fine-tuned BERT models with a nine-stage NLP pipeline, interactive dashboards, and PDF reports.
highlights: Built a nine-stage NLP pipeline combining sentiment analysis, BERTopic topic modeling, and LLM-generated summaries and insights.
Fine-tuned and evaluated two BERT models with PyTorch and Hugging Face: 12-category multi-label classification (80% weighted F1) and subjectivity detection (77% F1).
Integrated the pipeline into a desktop app with interactive dashboards and PDF reports, using LangChain for local inference with Ollama and optional OpenAI integration.

aboutMe.p1: I'm <highlight>Víctor Ángel López Romero</highlight>. I'm 23 and from Guanajuato, Mexico. I started programming with JavaScript, and at university I became interested in understanding how artificial intelligence worked. Studying it gave me a way to apply the mathematics and algorithms I was already learning.
aboutMe.p2: I now work in software development with a focus on AI. I'm interested in combining AI and web development to build applications that help people complete specific tasks and save time. I try to understand <highlight>what the person using the software needs</highlight> and keep the solution as simple as possible.
